description: Definitions shared by every LogDate lexicon.

recordRef.description: A reference to another LogDate record in the same space. Records in personal, circle and group spaces aren't publicly addressable, so they point at each other by type and key instead of by AT URI and CID.

collection.description: The referenced record's type, such as app.logdate.journal.entry.

media.description: A photo, video or audio file attached to a record.

blob.description: The stored file. In a personal, circle or group space this is ciphertext: the device encrypts the file in 64 KiB chunks with the account's media key (the LDCE2 format), not with the content key of the record that refers to it.

mimeType.description: The media type of the decrypted file, such as image/jpeg. The app records it when the file is imported or uploaded. The blob's own type describes the stored bytes, which may be ciphertext.

size.description: Size of the decrypted file in bytes.

alt.description: Text alternative for people who can't see or hear the media.

aspectRatio.description: Width and height of visual media, as a ratio. Used to lay out media before it loads.

location.description: Where something happened: the coordinates the device captured, a saved place, or both. At least one of geo and place is present.

geo.description: The captured coordinates. Altitude, when known, is decimal meters above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

accuracyCentimeters.description: Horizontal accuracy of the coordinates, in centimeters: the device's value in meters times 100, rounded to the nearest whole number with halves away from zero, and 0 if it was negative. Left out when the value is NaN or infinite. Digits below a centimeter are dropped; they're finer than any location sensor measures.

place.description: The saved place (app.logdate.place.place) this location belongs to, when there is one. Places are private only, so a shared copy of a record leaves place and placeDetails out unless the person chooses to share the place.

placeDetails.description: The place's name and center, written alongside place so the location still reads correctly on a device that doesn't have the place record, or after the place is deleted. It's a copy and can be out of date: when the place record is available, its name (after label corrections) and center are shown instead. Left out of shared copies unless the person chooses to share the place.
A copy of a place's name and center, as they were when the record referring to the place was last written.
